question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Tom waited until __________ to start working on his term paper but managed to finish it just in time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **the eleventh hour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"eleventh hour"** means the latest possible time before it is too late. (अंतिम समय)

 
 
• **Example:** He submitted his assignment at the eleventh hour, just before the deadline.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that Tom started working on his term paper at the last minute and completed it in time. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**
